Sent to VertMatch: the activity you choose, as a FIT file with its time, heart rate, speed, cadence and route. Received from VertMatch: your goal race and your training load for the last seven days. Nothing else is sent, and nothing is sent until you tap Send. Disconnecting deletes the sign-in from this phone.
